caption: The drawing features a single rectangular wooden chest placed against a plain, light-colored background. The chest is depicted in three-quarter view, showing both the front and right side. The main body of the chest is brown, with the woodgrain texture indicated by brown and lighter beige tones. Decorative patterns cover the front and side panels, consisting of symmetrical, swirling designs in a muted red color outlined with thin dark lines, filled with leaf or petal-like motifs in the background. The lid and base of the chest have simple carved edges, and a small keyhole is visible near the center of the front panel, suggesting the presence of a lock mechanism. The chest casts a soft shadow below, anchoring it visually on the neutral background.
title: Small Carved Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
